question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having numbers 7 to 12. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '9'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3c9c8040c80103bd2084d74b4868643bc5395e779ccced0d6a1dc7289aed381.png]
solution:
In figure 1 and 2 of the same dice,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3c9c8040c80103bd2084d74b4868643bc5395e779ccced0d6a1dc7289aed381.png]
